topic: SEMI Dec 2025 forecast of 2025 assembly & packaging equipment: US$6.0bn vs US$6.4bn
disagreement: The semi.org copy of SEMI's 16 Dec 2025 release gives US$6.0bn; the PR Newswire distribution of the same release gives US$6.4bn, both at +19.6%.
possible_reasons: transcription/edit: one version corrected after distribution
method: same growth rate implies only one base is consistent with 2024 actuals
rationale: SEMI's July 2026 release implies 2025 A&P actual ≈ US$6.1bn (US$6.7bn after +9.6%), closer to 6.0 than 6.4.
remaining_uncertainty: Which version SEMI considers official is not stated; 2025 actual A&P dollar value not published directly.

topic: Size of 2025 semiconductor equipment market: US$133bn forecast vs US$135.1bn billings vs ~US$134.7bn segment sum
disagreement: SEMI's Dec 2025 OEM forecast put 2025 total at US$133bn; WWSEMS billings for 2025 came in at US$135.1bn; WFE actual (US$116.9bn) plus implied back-end (~US$17.8bn) ≈ US$134.7bn.
possible_reasons: period: forecast made before Q4 actuals
method: OEM-sales forecast vs member billings statistic
rationale: Billings are reported actuals; the US$133bn was a forecast.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether SEMI's forecast basis and WWSEMS billings are defined identically is not stated.

topic: 2024 WFE size: SEMI US$104bn vs KLA 'approximately US$100bn'
disagreement: SEMI reports 2024 WFE at US$104bn; KLA describes 2024 WFE as approximately US$100bn.
possible_reasons: definition: KLA's WFE may exclude fab facilities or mask/reticle equipment, or China domestic vendors
rationale: KLA does not disclose its WFE definition; SEMI's includes fab facilities and mask/reticle equipment.
remaining_uncertainty: Vendor WFE definitions are not published.

topic: Tokyo Electron share of coater/developers: 92% (Gartner CY2024) vs 100% EUV vs CSET 96% TEL+Screen
disagreement: TEL cites 92% of all tracks (Gartner, CY2024), claims 100% of EUV tracks, while CSET (c.2021) gives 96% for TEL and Screen combined.
possible_reasons: population: all tracks vs EUV-only tracks
rationale: Figures measure different populations and years; all agree TEL dominates tracks.
remaining_uncertainty: Screen's separate share not published in the sources read.
